verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents structured relational data with typed columns, relationships, and indexes. It also offers a dedicated, managed native PostgreSQL database that developers connect to directly with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, which implies full SQL expressiveness. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents joins, constraint definitions, or transaction support in either the managed database API or the Postgres offering. missing for 10: explicit documentation of joins, constraints (foreign keys/unique), and transactions, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
